what_worked: Superwall median-revenue observation on slide 4 is a genuinely interesting, data-grounded finding worth exploring further.
fix_next: Replace decorative AI illustrations with real data charts; verify every statistic against the dataset and acknowledge missingness.
verdict: Mostly motivational filler with fabricated stats, one real chart, and corrupted AI graphics.
factual_error_detail: Slide 3: 68%/17%/10%/5% revenue buckets are unverifiable and likely fabricated. Slide 6: r=0.29 for followers-revenue correlation is unsourced (dataset Pearson r for founded-year/revenue is 0.025; no Twitter-follower field is documented). Slide 6: '80% grew revenue faster than audience' is fabricated—no longitudinal data exists. Slide 8: '1 in 5' (20%) stealth claim; actual anonymous share is 129/1000 = 12.9%. Slide 4: Stripe called '60% market share'—actual is 636/1000 = 63.6%, minor but imprecise. Slide 4: Stripe median stated as $234 vs reference value that is plausible but unconfirmed against frozen medians; Superwall median $4,159 vs chart label $4.16k is consistent but sample size not disclosed.

evidence.insight: Only slide 4's Superwall median observation offers non-obvious analytical depth. No category revenue analysis, no top-10 concentration (49.6%), no TLD comparison, no B2B/B2C multiples, no anonymity revenue-share analysis. Remaining slides are platitudes.
evidence.narrative: Loose arc from dataset intro to takeaways, but middle slides (geography, followers, stealth, outliers) are disconnected vignettes without a unifying thesis. Conclusion is generic motivational advice ('boring is profitable') untethered from specific data.
evidence.framing: No audience defined, no research question stated, no scope or limitations acknowledged. 24% missing country, 27–29% missing category/audience_type, 21.6% zero-revenue rows never mentioned. Dataset called 'verified, audited' without justification—misleading framing.
evidence.accuracy: At least 6 fabricated or unverifiable statistics across slides 3, 6, and 8. Revenue distribution percentages, follower correlation r=0.29, '80% grew faster,' and '1 in 5 stealth' all lack dataset support. Missing payment providers (Paddle, Lemon Squeezy) from slide 4 chart without explanation.
evidence.visual: One real data chart (slide 4 horizontal bar). Slides 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10 use large decorative AI illustrations conveying zero data. Slide 9 has visibly corrupted AI-generated graphic with garbled text ('Romeri CAT,' 'Sone %0$'). Repetitive three-card layouts on slides 7 and 11. No chart variety.
evidence.ai_slop: Pervasive: every slide features decorative AI art; consulting-buzzword language throughout ('The Anti-Hype Source,' 'The Winning Formula,' 'hidden economy'); slide 9 corrupted graphic is clear AI-generation artifact; generic card templates repeated.

change_reason: Lowered accuracy by 0.5 (fabricated stats more numerous than preliminary weighted) and visual by 0.5 (slide 9 corrupted graphic is a serious quality failure). Framing also lowered 0.5 for calling dataset 'audited' without basis and zero limitations disclosure. Insight and narrative unchanged—preliminary was already fair.
